reference.profile: public deployed/full-range export; not study training source
reference.body_gravity_compensation: all massive robot bodies gravcomp=1; native nominal task still uses encoder gravity feedforward at50Hz
reference.native_profile_deviation: 100/50 solver iterations, nominal parallel-jaw gripper/material, uncalibrated arm, held gravity feedforward; no claim of full model/dynamics equivalence

paired_oracle.qualification: privileged controller diagnostic, not learned policy

grip_hold.scope: 5 mm one-time encoder-FK/DLS lift, then immutable joint targets; initial COM support only; measured part slip never feeds control

capacity4096.limitation: 25 zero-action control steps; no PPO update/reset stress; diagnostic readbacks included; unrelated GPU processes can affect total-device samples

phase_a_training.qualification: superseded physical profile; real native PPO random initialization
phase_a_training.reason_for_restart: diagnosed excessive axial slip; public source friction cone/impratio differ; phaseB starts from random weights, no optimizer/normalizer reuse

limits: one fixed stadium per run, fixed ready robot pose and local offsets
parallel-jaw approximation retains real contact but does not preserve author closed linkage
these experiments do not establish full task-distribution, 12288 capacity, or micron precision qualification

task_fixture_correction.implementation: mjfit public generator; one convex mesh attached to the existing plate body
task_fixture_correction.qualification: privileged action-only controller diagnostic, not a learned result
task_fixture_correction.free_peg_properties: mass,COM,inertia,mesh vertices unchanged from open-bottom task; CPU regression and elevated-drop reference passed

superseded_open_bottom_training.reason: public fixture has a local floor; the prior task omitted it
superseded_open_bottom_training.capacity_and_convergence_flags: no loss or budget flags observed in 2814 train and1000 eval completed control boundaries
superseded_open_bottom_training.raw_native_state_finiteness: not sampled by that already-imported observer; finite RL loss logs are not equivalent evidence
superseded_open_bottom_training.disposition: superseded scene; does not qualify the corrected task; V4 does not reuse its weights

native_initialization_clock.interpretation: source CUDA-graph warm-up advances solver once and rewinds Newton state; MuJoCo clock and all warm-start internals are not restored. This explains an initial clock offset; it does not prove extra visible physical evolution or initialization equivalence. Individual-substep clocks were not sampled.
